Summary: [AUTH] Authentication & Role-Based Access
Description: Session login/logout, password reset, staff account management and role middleware (admin, librarian, member).

Summary: [CAT] Catalog Management
Description: Books, physical copies (barcodes), authors, publishers and categories with server-side DataTables.

Summary: [MEM] Membership Management
Description: Members, membership plans, expiry handling and the member self-service portal.

Summary: [CIRC] Circulation (Borrow / Return)
Description: Barcode borrow, return, due-date rules, overdue detection, fines, lost/damaged handling, renewals.

Summary: [RES] Reservations
Description: Members place holds on unavailable titles; FIFO allocation on return; hold expiry.

Summary: [REV] Reviews & Ratings
Description: Members rate and review titles they have borrowed; staff moderation.

Summary: [NOTI] Notifications
Description: In-app and email reminders for due/overdue loans and ready reservations.

Summary: [AUD] Audit Logging
Description: Track create/update/delete on core tables with old/new values, user and IP.

Summary: [DASH] Dashboard & Reports
Description: Staff KPI dashboard, charts, and exportable reports.

Summary: [QA] Quality, Security & DevOps
Description: Test suite, CI pipeline, environments, security review and release.

Summary: As a user, I can sign in with email and password
Description:
As a library user I want to sign in so that I can access features for my role.

Acceptance criteria:
- Valid credentials redirect to the role's home page
- Invalid credentials show a generic error and keep the email filled
- Guest-only middleware on /login; auth middleware on everything else

Summary: As an admin, routes are restricted by role
Description:
RoleMiddleware aliased as `role` restricts route groups.

Acceptance criteria:
- CRUD resources require role:admin,librarian
- Borrow/return requires role:admin,librarian,member
- Unauthorized access returns 403

Summary: As a user, I can reset a forgotten password
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Forgot-password form sends a signed, expiring token by email
- Token stored hashed in password_reset_tokens and invalidated after use
- New password must meet policy (min 8 chars)

Summary: As an admin, I can manage staff user accounts
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- List, create, edit, soft-delete users with role admin/librarian
- Creating a staff user also creates the linked staff record
- Admin cannot delete their own account

Summary: Record last_login on successful sign-in
Description: Update users.last_login in LoginController@store after Auth::attempt succeeds.

Summary: As a librarian, I can manage books with cover images
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Create/edit/delete book with unique ISBN, title, publisher, category, many authors, year, pages, language, shelf location
- Cover image uploaded to public disk books/covers and previewed in list
- Soft delete keeps history

Summary: As a librarian, I can manage authors, publishers and categories
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- CRUD for each entity with validation (unique author email, unique category slug)
- Each list page is a server-side DataTable

Summary: As a librarian, I can manage physical copies with barcodes
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Add copies to a book with unique barcode
- Status is one of available, borrowed, damaged, lost (BookCopyStatus enum)
- Status badge rendered with status_badge() helper

Summary: As a librarian, I can view a book detail page with copy availability
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Shows counts per copy status
- Lists copies currently on loan with member and due date
- Shows average rating once reviews exist

Summary: As a librarian, I can bulk import books from CSV
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Upload CSV with ISBN, title, authors, publisher, category, copies
- Dry-run preview with row-level errors before commit
- Import runs in a single transaction per batch

Summary: As a librarian, I can print barcode labels for copies
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Select copies and generate a printable PDF sheet of Code128 labels

Summary: book_authors / reviews / audit_logs lack FK constraints and use mismatched int types
Description:
G6: these tables use unsignedInteger columns with no foreign keys while parent PKs are bigint.

Fix: new migration converting to foreignId()->constrained() with appropriate onDelete; add composite PK on book_authors.

Summary: As a librarian, I can register and manage members
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Member code, name, email, phone, address, plan, join/expiry dates, status
- Status one of active, inactive, suspend, expired

Summary: As an admin, I can manage membership plans
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Plan has name, loan_duration_days, fine_per_day, discount_fee, description
- Deleting a plan sets members.plan_id to null

Summary: As the system, I expire members past their expiry date daily
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Scheduled command members:expire runs daily at 00:15
- Sets status=expired where expiry_date < today and status=active
- Writes an audit log entry per change

Summary: As a librarian, I can view a member profile with loans and fines
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Tabs: active loans, history, reservations, fines owed
- Quick action: start a borrow for this member

Summary: As a member, I have a self-service portal home
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Link members to users (members.user_id) so members can sign in
- Home lists active loans with due dates and overdue highlight, reservations, unread notifications

Summary: As a librarian, I can look up an available copy by barcode
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- POST /borrow-books/get-book-by-barcode returns book, authors, publisher, category for an available copy
- Unknown or unavailable barcode shows an inline error

Summary: As a librarian, I can borrow multiple copies for a member in one transaction
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- One borrow_transactions row per copy; copies flip to borrowed
- All writes in DB::transaction

Summary: As a librarian, the due date defaults from the member plan
Description:
G4.
Acceptance criteria:
- Selecting a member fills due_date = borrow_date + plan.loan_duration_days
- Staff may override; server validates due_date >= borrow_date

Summary: As the system, I block borrowing for ineligible members
Description:
G5.
Acceptance criteria:
- Reject when member.status != active or expiry_date < today
- Reject when active loans + requested copies > 5 (config library.max_loans)
- Clear validation message on the borrow form

Summary: Returning a book does not set loan status to returned
Description:
G1: BorrowRepository::returnBook updates return_date only; status stays active.

Expected: status = returned (or overdue->returned) together with return_date.

Summary: Return is not atomic
Description:
G2: returnBook updates borrow_transactions and book_copies without DB::transaction.

Fix: wrap in DB::transaction and lock the transaction row (lockForUpdate) to prevent double return.

Summary: staff_id on borrow transactions stores a users.id instead of staff.id
Description:
G3: createBorrowTransaction sets staff_id : auth()->id(); FK targets staff.id.

Fix: resolve auth()->user()->staff?->id; null when a member self-borrows.

Summary: As the system, I flag overdue loans daily
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Scheduled command loans:mark-overdue sets status=overdue where due_date < today and return_date is null
- Dashboard overdue tile reflects result

Summary: As a librarian, I see the fine due when returning an overdue book
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Fine = max(0, return_date - due_date in days) * plan.fine_per_day
- Shown on return confirmation and member profile
- Stored on the transaction (new column fine_amount)

Summary: As a librarian, I can mark a copy lost or damaged at return
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Return dialog offers condition: good, damaged, lost
- Copy status and loan status updated accordingly

Summary: As a member, I can renew a loan once
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Allowed once, only if not overdue and no pending reservation on the title
- New due date = current due date + plan days

Summary: As a member, I can reserve a title with no available copies
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Reserve button visible only when available copies = 0
- One pending reservation per member per title

Summary: As the system, I allocate a returned copy to the next reservation
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- On return, oldest pending reservation for the title gets notified_at=now, expires_at=now+3 days
- Copy held (not borrowable by others) until expiry

Summary: As a member or librarian, I can cancel a reservation; expired holds auto-expire
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Cancel sets status=cancelled
- Scheduled job sets status=expired after expires_at and releases the copy to the next in queue

Summary: As a member, I can rate and review a book I have borrowed
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Rating 1-5 required, text optional up to 2000 chars
- Only after a returned loan of that title (BR-07); one review per member per book

Summary: As a librarian, I can moderate reviews
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Book page shows average rating and reviews
- Staff can soft-delete a review with reason

Summary: As a member, I get reminders before and after my due date
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Queued job sends email + creates notifications row 2 days before due and on first overdue day
- No duplicate reminders for the same loan/event

Summary: As a member, I am notified when my reservation is ready
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Notification includes title, pickup deadline (expires_at)

Summary: As a user, I see unread notifications in the navbar bell
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Replace theme demo dropdown with real data
- Badge shows unread count; opening an item sets read_at

Summary: As an admin, every data change is written to the audit log
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Model observer/trait on Book, BookCopy, Member, MemberPlan, BorrowTransaction, User
- Stores table, action, user_id, record_id, old/new JSON, IP

Summary: As an admin, I can browse and filter the audit log
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- DataTable filtered by table, user, action, date range
- Diff view of old vs new values

Summary: As a librarian, I see real KPI tiles on the dashboard
Description:
Replace theme placeholder content in resources/views/index.blade.php.

Acceptance criteria:
- Tiles: total titles, copies available, active loans, overdue loans, active members
- Each tile links to the filtered list

Summary: As a librarian, I see circulation charts on the dashboard
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Loans per day for 30 days (line)
- Top 5 borrowed titles (bar)
- Works in light and dark mode

Summary: As an admin, I can export circulation and inventory reports
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Overdue report, circulation by date range, inventory by status
- Export CSV and PDF

Summary: Project setup: Laravel 12, SQLite, Docker/Sail, layered architecture
Description: Repository/Service pattern, AppServiceProvider bindings, global helpers.

Summary: Add dark mode theme toggle
Description: Theme toggle persisted per user/browser.

Summary: Feature test suite for auth, catalog and circulation
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Factories for all models
- Tests for role access, borrow (happy + ineligible), return, overdue job
- composer test green; coverage >= 70% of services

Summary: CI pipeline: Pint, tests on SQLite and MySQL
Description: GitHub Actions workflow runs pint --test and php artisan test against SQLite and a MySQL 8 service container on every PR.

Summary: Index review for list and dashboard queries
Description: Add indexes on borrow_transactions(status, due_date), book_copies(status), members(status); verify NFR-01 with 50k seeded books.

Summary: Security review (OWASP Top 10) and hardening
Description: Check CSRF, mass assignment, upload validation (mime/size), authorization on every route, rate-limit login.

Summary: User acceptance testing with library staff
Description: UAT scripts per epic; log defects; PO sign-off.

Summary: Production deployment and backups
Description: Provision MySQL, configure queue worker + scheduler, storage:link, nightly backups with 30-day retention.
